about.title: About Me...
about.description:
My journey with programming started in my teenage years, when I experimented with languages such as BASIC and Fortran. Later, while studying Automation and Control in Technical Systems at university, I learned Pascal and developed a stronger interest in software development. After graduation, programming remained one of my main hobbies, and I continued expanding my knowledge of Java and JavaScript.

About three years ago, I decided to turn my passion for programming into a career. Since then, I have been learning intensively and building practical projects to develop my skills and gain experience.

Today, I focus mainly on frontend development, working with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and Next.js. I have also worked with Angular and backend technologies such as Node.js, NestJS, Express, and AWS. I enjoy exploring new technologies and, most importantly, putting them into practice by building real applications.

I’m now looking for an opportunity to join a professional development team where I can contribute my skills, learn from experienced developers, and continue growing as a software engineer. I value clean and maintainable code, solving problems, and working together to build useful software.
